description: This file defines a validation rule class named 'Color' used in the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding plugin API. The class extends an abstract validation rule and implements a method to validate color inputs using a theme service.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if an input string is a valid color according to the theme's SCSS helper.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the input is a valid color by delegating to the theme service's SCSS helper.
